business_problem: Mascoma Bank lacked a unified customer view across legacy banking systems, which slowed service, limited cross-sell visibility, and made it hard to personalize outreach for customers on different financial journeys.
solution_summary: Mascoma Bank uses Data Cloud as a unification layer across digital banking, loan servicing, origination, CRM, core banking, website, general ledger, and other legacy systems so employees can work from one customer record. Financial Services Cloud sits on top of that profile to expose interaction, behavioral, and transaction data to bankers, while CRM Analytics analyzes customer behavior and transaction history to surface cross-sell and upsell opportunities. Automation in Financial Services Cloud handles repetitive service work such as documentation requests, e-signature collection, and online account opening, shrinking account setup time from 45 minutes to just minutes. Service Cloud Voice extends the same model into the contact center by unifying voice and digital channels, attaching transcripts and summaries to customer records, and giving agents the context needed to answer questions faster and investigate potential fraud.

solution_components.name: Data Cloud
solution_components.role: Consolidates customer and operational data from Mascoma's legacy systems into unified profiles.

solution_components.name: Financial Services Cloud
solution_components.role: Provides banker workflows and automation on top of unified financial customer records.

solution_components.name: CRM Analytics
solution_components.role: Analyzes customer behavior and transaction history to surface cross-sell and upsell opportunities.

solution_components.name: Service Cloud Voice
solution_components.role: Brings call, transcript, and omnichannel service context into the customer record.

data_flow: Customer and operational data from legacy banking systems is unified in Data Cloud, enriched in Financial Services Cloud, analyzed in CRM Analytics, and surfaced to bankers and service agents. Service Cloud Voice adds call transcripts and summaries so the same record can drive service, fraud review, and personalized follow-up.
business_outcome: Mascoma Bank created a proactive, profile-driven engagement model that speeds onboarding, reduces hold times, improves service quality, and gives bankers better signals for personalized outreach and cross-sell conversations.
metrics: 45 minutes cut of manual data per new loan
98% decrease in call center hold times
13 days to process 1 year's worth of loans
architecture_clues: Data Cloud is used as the single profile layer across dozens of legacy systems.
Financial Services Cloud automation supports documentation and e-signature workflows.
Service Cloud Voice attaches transcripts and call summaries directly to the customer record.
Future personalized offers are planned from near-real-time Data Cloud indicators such as credit scores and deposit behavior.
